description: Add a marker to a sequence or a clip project item at a time, with a name, type, duration, comments and colour. The colour is a second undo step

duration.description: Seconds; 0 for a point marker. Default 0

item.description: Markers of this clip project item instead of a sequence

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

sequence.description: Markers of this sequence (default: the active sequence)

name: add_marker
title: Add Marker
